headline: Russian Strikes on Ukrainian Humanitarian Aid Center Kill 26
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians after Russian strikes on a shelter and aid distribution center killed 26 people.
why: Escalations in the Russia-Ukraine conflict directly affect European security, geopolitical risk premiums, and global agricultural and energy supply chains.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Military strikes on infrastructure increase geopolitical risks and human costs.
